whatsappMessage:
Hi Rebel Spoken English Team,

I noticed your institute has exceptional 4.8★ reviews with 350+ happy students on Boring Road, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for new course inquiries and batch timings.

Maine aapke institute ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp trial booking, spoken English programs, aur batch schedules integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/rebelspoken

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Rebel Spoken English Team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke business (Rebel Spoken English) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar Boring Road location ke hisab se WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp trial booking and mobile-first batch schedules for your students in Patna. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact course details, actual photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
